description: This file is a PHP source file defining a Smarty plugin modifier function called 'smarty_modifier_json_decode'. It includes license and copyright information for SugarCRM and SuiteCRM, as well as a security check before defining the function. The function decodes a JSON string into a PHP array, with error handling.

methods.name: smarty_modifier_json_decode
methods.description: Decodes a JSON string into a PHP array, after decoding HTML entities. Returns an empty array for invalid or empty input.
